title: NASA’s Hubble Seeks Lensed Supernova, Marks 200,000 Orbits
summary: NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope completed its 200,000th orbit around Earth on Sept. 19, marking another new milestone for an observatory that continues to transform our understanding of the universe.
